strings: As if m_c's day already wasn't horrible enough. As {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/enter/enters} the medicine den r_c0 has to catch {PRONOUN/m_c/object} when the leg the rat bit gives out.
Gingerly m_c attempts to stand up. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} leg wobbles and barely seems to want to sustain {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.

m_c asks a denmate for assistance to the medicine den. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} not so proud to hide that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} leg doesn't want to fully support {PRONOUN/m_c/object} anymore.
